[NRTM.1.1] In RT mode the engine runs from **pre-allocated slab pools** — facts,
tokens, and activations are carved from arenas sized at configuration time, so
steady-state operation does no `malloc`. The working-memory bound `N_max`
becomes a **hard** limit, and join fan-out is capped. This is what makes
worst-case execution time and memory bounded for embedded / deadline-driven
deployments.
